data.description:
## Context
The MCP reference generator selects the first physical description line. Wrapped registrar prose therefore yields truncated summaries. The accepted first-line choice is recorded on `lupine-clearcut-mare`. The `transition_ticket` registrar also says close classes are ignored for non-bug tickets although the administrative subset is supported.

## Plan
- Normalize the complete first description paragraph into one generated summary.
- Stop summary extraction at the next paragraph.
- Correct the `transition_ticket` registrar description without changing its schema or behavior.
- Regenerate `docs/mcp-reference.md`.
- Add focused generator and registrar contract tests.
- Do not add duplicate summary metadata or a general prose validator.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every generated MCP summary is a complete first paragraph rather than a physical-line fragment.
- [x] Wrapped descriptions render as one complete summary.
- [x] Paragraphs after the summary remain excluded.
- [x] `transition_ticket` documents bug classifications and the non-bug administrative subset accurately.
- [x] Generated-reference and focused MCP tests pass.
- [x] MCP schemas and runtime behavior are unchanged.
data.title: F13 generate complete MCP summaries
